home.title: Biodiversity Evaluation Engine
home.description: The Biodiversity Evaluation Engine is an open tool aiming to enhance the capacity of Biodiversity Observation Networks and countries to report on biodiversity effectively. It connects individual analyses scripts into automated pipelines that convert data into Essential Biodiversity Variables (EBVs) and indicators. These community-built pipelines can analyze public or user datasets, and can be shared for auditability, reproducibility, and transparency.
